properties.name: BGo Curb to Curb
properties.note: BCRTA's own BGo service-area KML, linked from its BGo page (the page's map viewer doesn't render it). About 524 sq mi vs. Butler County's 470, so the service area extends past the county line. Layer published by Butler County Regional Transit Authority, last modified 2025-04-25 (https://www.butlercountyrta.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/BCRTA_BGo_04252025.kml). Fetched 2026-11-19.

properties.name: Dayton RTA Connect On-Demand
properties.note: Service covers 4 zones in Montgomery County (Miami Valley); using county as proxy.

properties.name: Fairfield County LINK Direct
properties.note: Primary service area is Fairfield County (Lancaster area); also offers out-of-county trips up to 50 miles statewide but core service is county-based.

properties.name: Knox County Transit
properties.note: Primary service area is Knox County (Mount Vernon area); also offers out-of-county trips throughout Ohio but core service is county-based.

properties.name: MCFlex (Medina County)
properties.note: Serves Wadsworth and Medina City; Brunswick planned for expansion.

properties.name: METRO NEXT
properties.note: Service covers Northern, Southern, Eastern, Western zones in Summit County outside Akron METRO fixed-route service; using county as proxy.

properties.name: MetroNow! (Cincinnati Metro)
